thread_title: Is the new Pro price worth it?

posts.author: maria_k
posts.text: Is the new Pro price worth it? It went from 4 to 7 a month and our lab of six is now asking whether we should all move to something cheaper.

posts.author: night_owl_notes
posts.text: I pay it because the templates save me hours every week, but I understand why a lab would balk at paying for six seats.

posts.author: tomasz_r
posts.text: We cancelled the team plan in April. Nobody could justify the jump to the department, so half of us went back to the free tier.

posts.author: night_owl_notes
posts.text: The free tier caps you at 1,000 notes though, which you hit fast if you clip papers.

posts.author: lena.v
posts.text: Honestly the price is fine for what it does, my problem is how slow search gets once it's full.

posts.author: quietdesk
posts.text: I would pay more if offline mode worked properly on the train.

posts.author: night_owl_notes
posts.text: Offline has improved since March but it still loses the last edit sometimes.

posts.author: pb_writes
posts.text: Students get half price if you email support with a university address.

posts.author: deal_hunter_x
posts.text: Use my code QUILL20 for a discount on Pro, link in bio!

posts.author: night_owl_notes
posts.text: For the record I'd still recommend it to a solo researcher at the new price.
